title: Farmer body backs demand for land pooling policy in Chandigarh
summary: A farmer organization has backed a demand for a land pooling policy in Chandigarh. The move aims to facilitate better land use and agricultural development in the union territory.
digest: A farmer body operating in Chandigarh has expressed support for the implementation of a land pooling policy in the union territory. Land pooling is intended to consolidate fragmented agricultural holdings and improve land management efficiency. The farmer organization views this policy as beneficial for collective farming efforts and modernization. The policy would allow farmers to pool their land resources while retaining ownership rights. Agricultural officials and the farming community are engaged in dialogue regarding the policy's framework and implementation timeline.
id: farmer body backs demand for land pooling policy in chandigarh
